module: Shared helper for smooth movement and zoom for the big map camera modes (bigMap / bigMapOrtho). Placed outside cameraModes/ because the files in that folder are automatically loaded as camera constructors. The functions directly modify the fields of the camera mode passed as a parameter (cam).
usage:
local pan = core_cameraUtils_bigMapPan
pan.setTarget(cam, vec3(100, 200, 0), cam.camToLookAtPoint)
pan.zoomToFactor(cam, 0.5)
-- every frame in cam:update:
pan.update(cam, data.dt, userMoving)
notes: Fields read/written on cam: bigMapCamPosition (vec3), panTarget, zoomTarget, fovMin, fovMax, manualzoom.fov.
Smoothing uses t = clamp(dt*6, 0, 1); the target is removed when the gap is below 0.1 m (squared < 0.01) for movement, or 0.01 for zoom (fov).
update reads MoveManager.zoomIn / zoomOut: a manual zoom cancels zoomTarget; a user movement cancels panTarget and zoomTarget.

setTarget.desc: Sets cam.panTarget to center the view on worldPos: x,y = worldPos minus the offset; z = that of cam.bigMapCamPosition (otherwise that of worldPos). Does nothing if worldPos is nil.

lookAtOffset.desc: camera -> aimed point vector (camToLookAtPoint) of the calling mode; (0,0,0) by default

zoomToFactor.desc: Sets cam.zoomTarget by interpolation between fovMax (factor 0, zoomed out) and fovMin (factor 1, zoomed in).

factor.desc: 0 = zoomed out (fovMax), 1 = zoomed in (fovMin); clamped to [0,1], non-numeric = 0

update.desc: To call every frame: moves manualzoom.fov toward zoomTarget and bigMapCamPosition (x,y) toward panTarget, and cancels the targets if the user moves or zooms.

userMoving.desc: true if the user is moving the camera (cancels the targets)
